headroom.reason: The installed interface exposes a provider proxy and evaluation commands over LLM or recorded-session workflows, not a standalone equivalent context transform. A run would require new proxy/upstream routing, credentials or a non-equivalent dummy protocol and could touch external model/cache state. Existing configured routing and private sessions were intentionally not used.
